goal: Graduate Jichi Insight as a nationwide municipality insight platform. Continue autonomously from Phase 15 through complete canonical coverage, public-product alignment, and final runtime verification; preserve fiscal/document/version distinctions and evidence boundaries. For missing paths, planner steps must explicitly say 'Create new file <exact-path>' so new_paths is declared.
graduation_criteria: Canonical coverage includes every intended municipality; each is validly evidenced or explicitly unresolved, never omitted.
Evidence retains official URLs, stable locators, plan/version/period/fiscal/availability boundaries, provenance and deferred depth; no invented facts, causality, comparisons, rankings or scores.

Candidate generation, validation, review staging, promotion and public-data pipelines are deterministic, resumable and free of machine-resolvable blockers; required human review gates remain explicit.
Public browse/search/detail uses current canonical nationwide data and passes repository plus production smoke checks.
CI, regression, data-quality and final runtime verification are green; queue exhaustion or campaign completion alone never means project completion. Only the verified completion marker does.
